notes: All 13 source and 19 target ids partitioned once.

The three-level chain עֲבוֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים carries one article morpheme against three written *the*s. The accepted reading puts the article's *the* at the left edge of its own immediate phrase (*the house* of *the house of God*) and supplies the two outer ones, which matches rule 29's parenthetical that the article's own *the* leaves the further *the* for the outer construct (לְבַב כָּל בְּנֵי הָאָדָם → *the hearts of all the children of men*). The competing leftmost reading is recorded in the unit note.
Head on *appointed* rather than the auxiliary *were* is correct under rule 24.
